description: Write content to a file, completely replacing existing content. Use this instead of echo/cat heredoc in terminal. Creates parent directories automatically. OVERWRITES the entire file by default — use 'patch' for targeted edits; create_only=true instead refuses any existing path. For an EXISTING file, call read_file first: write_file refuses (file remains untouched) when this task has no current full read/write of the file or the file changed on disk since; on refusal, read_file, merge, then retry. Auto-runs syntax checks on .py/.json/.yaml/.toml and other linted languages; only NEW errors introduced by this write are surfaced (pre-existing errors are filtered out). The result's verified:true means the file written to disk matches the content supplied to write_file after UTF-8 encoding and preservation of any existing CRLF line endings or UTF-8 BOM. It does not validate the content's correctness or completeness. Use the verified:true return value and do not reread solely to confirm successful persistence.
name: write_file

content.description: Complete content to write to the file

create_only.description: Atomically create a new file; any existing entry (even a symlink) is left untouched and returns status=already_exists.

path.description: Path to the file to write (will be created if it doesn't exist, overwritten if it does)
